## Custom GUI Mod v1.2.7

v1.2.7 introduces the Multi-Status Rune Foundation. Rune purchases, duplicate compensation, progression, paid awakening, client synchronization, and GUI status switching are now routed through the active rune status instead of relying on Poison-only assumptions.

### Added
- Added a central rune status registry and status-aware routing for the existing rune lifecycle.
- Added isolated economy configuration per rune status.
- Added client synchronization for the active rune status and status-specific economy data.
- Added regression coverage for multi-status routing and economy isolation.
- Added a user-facing Poison status label while preserving existing stored collection data.
- Added a safe vanilla gunpowder fallback when rune textures are unavailable.

### Fixed
- Switching between rune statuses no longer shows a temporary `Loading...` purchase state.
- Status switching no longer prints internal active-deck messages to chat.
- Rune purchase price labels use the correct localized resource wording.
- Resource-pack reloads now restore distinct rune textures after disabling and re-enabling the pack instead of leaving fallback or duplicated textures cached.
- Status-specific purchase and awakening data no longer leak between collections.

### Other
- This release is a foundation release: it does not add the full set of future damaging statuses or finalize their economy and progression balance.
- Poison remains the currently configured gameplay baseline status.
- Existing rune ranks remain Ordinary, Improved, and Advanced.
- Rune upgrade remains a separate, unimplemented mechanic; paid awakening behavior is unchanged from v1.2.6.
- Existing rune purchase, duplicate compensation, progression, and paid awakening behavior passed runtime regression checks.
- Manual runtime validation covered multi-status switching, status isolation, chat suppression, purchase labels, and resource-pack fallback/reload behavior.
- Feature, develop, and main CI validation completed successfully before release preparation.
- Updated the mod version metadata to `1.2.7`.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.7.jar` on both client and server.

Compatible resource pack: [RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0), available in 64x64 and 128x128 variants.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.6...v1.2.7](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.6...v1.2.7)
